program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1)
      (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) r0) (= (first p) r1) (= (second p) c0) (= (second p) c1)))
              (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1)))
    (define (same-cells? a b)
      (and (= (length a) (length b)) (all? (lambda (p) (member? p b)) a)))
    (define (marker-for bb markers)
      (let ((r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb)) (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
        (find-first
          (lambda (m)
            (let ((r (first m)) (c (second m)))
              (or (and (= r (- r0 1)) (<= c0 c) (<= c c1))
                  (and (= r (+ r1 1)) (<= c0 c) (<= c c1))
                  (and (= c (- c0 1)) (<= r0 r) (<= r r1))
                  (and (= c (+ c1 1)) (<= r0 r) (<= r r1)))))
          markers)))
    (let* ((frames (filter (lambda (o)
                             (and (= (obj-color o) 4)
                                  ;; Bounding box (r1 c1 r2 c2) of o
                                  (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
                                    (same-cells? (obj-cells o) (rect-border (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))))
                           (objects g 0)))
           ;; Cells filtered out of every (r,c) position
           (markers (filter (lambda (p) (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p)))) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 4))))) (grid-positions g)))
           (hit (find-first (lambda (o) (marker-for (obj-bbox o) markers)) frames)))
      (if hit
          ;; Bounding box (r1 c1 r2 c2) of hit
          (let* ((bb (obj-bbox hit))
                 (marker (marker-for bb markers))
                 (fill (at g (first marker) (second marker)))
                 ;; Positions of every color 0 cell
                 (inside (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0))
                                 (positions-in-rect (+ (first bb) 1) (+ (second bb) 1) (- (third bb) 1) (- (fourth bb) 1)))))
            (paint-cells g inside fill))
          g))))
